es.title: Elegir una alarma para casa. Guía para proteger tu hogar según las necesidades que tengas
es.description: Las alarmas para casa se han convertido en un elemento de confianza máxima. Son muchas las familias que apuestan por un sistema que sirva de protección extra para la vivienda en la que residimos, para que podamos estar sin ninguna preocupación en el interior de nuestro hogar. Si bien éstas antes únicamente se veían en las fincas de campo o casonas aisladas, hoy el conjunto se contrata para muchas modalidades. Hoy, con una demanda que ha crecido con el paso de los años, nos encontramos con empresas muy diferentes en las que podemos hacer la contratación de la nuestra, esa con la que nos sintamos seguros en todo momento. Conociendo todos los detalles gracias a la cantidad de información que tenemos en Internet, se puede decir que resulta mucho más sencillo dar con la nuestra, con esa que reúna las características que la hacen única en su especie. Al escoger alarmas para casa que reúnan todas las condiciones que precisamos debemos tener ciertos aspectos en cuenta desde un inicio. Con cantidad de modelos de entre los que podemos elegir, la idea es que tengas bajo control esas características que te convienen, los puntos que te hacen falta para que la protección de tu sitio sea exactamente lo primero. Atendiendo a la manera en la que ya han ayudado a millones de hogares en España, sólo tendremos que tomar nota de lo que éstos contrataron para sacar la máxima rentabilidad, para observar cómo para ellos fue una solución en el momento. En cualquier caso, con la idea de que tu vivienda esté sumamente protegida, el detalle es que pensemos en las necesidades que tiene nuestra residencia pero, ¿cómo lo hacemos? A continuación, para que no te pierdas, te dejamos con varios consejos: Evaluar las características de nuestra vivienda Lo primero que tenemos que hacer antes de escoger la alarma para casa es valorar el espacio en el que vivimos. ¿Estamos ante un chalet, un piso o una casa en medio del campo? Esto, que puede parecer algo lógico, no siempre se tiene en cuenta cuando hablamos de instalar nuestro sistema así que, ahora que estamos planteando el hecho de hacernos con la nuestra, sí que debemos ponerlo sobre la mesa. Comparativa de las alarmas Cada año salen nuevos modelos de alarmas al mercado y es por ello que debemos estar actualizados sobre los últimos sistemas que han entrado. Hacer comparativas es una de las formas más inmediatas de dar con aquella que necesitamos, con la que de verdad reúne las características necesarias para que podamos disfrutar de lo que ofrece a los hogares. Planteando qué es lo que quieres así como el presupuesto que tienes para gastar, darás con la que mantendrá protegida a tu familia, con la que no necesita carta de presentación alguna para que la coloques en el rincón que la prefieras. Hoy, gracias a Internet, además, tenemos la oportunidad de saber qué es lo que opinan el resto de consumidores sobre aquella que te ha gustado, sobre la que crees que será la idónea. Conectividad del sistema La tecnología está inmersa en casi todos los aparatos de los que hacemos uso en nuestros días. Valorar la conectividad de la que dispone nuestro sistema de aviso es una forma de asegurar su funcionamiento, también, cuando estamos lejos de casa. Son muchas las familias que necesitan estar viendo qué es lo que ocurre dentro de la estancia cuando estamos fuera para estar más tranquilos así que nada como una pantalla que nos muestre la realidad. ¿No te parece? Soporte técnico de calidad Contar con un soporte técnico de calidad resulta fundamental para que podamos hacer buen uso del sistema que instalamos. Es importante que, en el momento en que nos hagamos con una alarma para casa, veas que el mantenimiento es sencillo, que el equipo está dispuesto a aparecer en la vivienda siempre que haya problemas o que el conjunto no te vaya como esperabas. ¡No pases este punto por alto! Instalación sencilla La instalación del sistema de alerta que hayamos colocado en casa también debe de ser sencilla. En ocasiones, nos complicamos demasiado con la manera en la que van puestas cada una de las partes y, en el momento en que éstas no funcionen como es debido, vendrán los problemas. Los modelos con interfaz intuitiva y llaman a los profesionales para que hagan su tratamiento, suelen ser las más efectivas del mercado. ¿Con cuál de ellas te quedas? Como vemos, elegir una alarma para casa que vaya con nuestro modelo de vivienda tiene aspectos que debemos controlar, detalles que harán que ésta nos dure lo máximo posible desde su instalación. Ideal para que todas las habitaciones del hogar estén bajo vigilancia, seguro que pronto empiezas a agradecer el hecho de contar con una allí donde reside tu familia.

pl.title: Filip Chajzer ślubował w kościele. Mówi wprost, co sądzi o ślubie cywilnym

Jedno z pytań od widzów dotyczyło ceremonii cywilnych oraz prawa par jednopłciowych do zawierania małżeństw. Dziennikarz nie miał żadnych wątpliwości.

pl.title: Zapłakana El Dursi oficjalnie ogłosiła koniec. "Muszę ruszyć w nową drogę"
pl.description: Ten moment musiał nadejść dla Klaudii El Dursi, ale i tak nie mogła ukryć łez, kiedy przyszło się jej pożegnać. Mokre oczy mieli nawet uczestnicy "Hotelu Paradise". Wszystko zaczęło się już w marcu, kiedy w TVN zapanowało wielkie zamieszanie. W najnowszym odcinku programu lubiana prowadząca oficjalnie oddała stery Edycie Zając.

pl.title: Milion dzieci wraz Leonem XIV modli się o pokój
pl.description: Leon XIV zachęcając najmłodszych do wspólnej modlitwy różańcowej w intencji pokoju podkreślił, że jest to prosta modlitwa, którą może odmawiać każdy. Przypomniał sceny z życia Jezusa rozważane w tajemnicach światła: chrzest w Jordanie, cud w Kanie Galilejskiej, głoszenie Królestwa Bożego, przemienienie na górze Tabor oraz ustanowienie Eucharystii podczas Ostatniej Wieczerzy.

pl.title: Ewa Kryza to jedna z najładniejszych uczestniczek programu TVP "Rolnik szuka żony". Tak wygląda 33-latka na prywatnych zdjęciach
pl.description: Ewa Kryza zyskała rozpoznawalność za sprawą 10. edycji “Rolnik szuka żony”. 33-latka była kandydatką Waldemara. W czasie trwania programu wydawało się, że ta dwójka predysponuje do zawarcia związku i pozostania w bliższej relacji po zakończeniu show, finalnie Waldemar związał się z inną uczestniczką, Dorotą. Czym dziś zajmuje się Ewa? Skupiła się na rozwoju własnej marki osobistej. Łączy rolę mamy z karierą artystyczną.

pl.title: Dziennikarka radiowa zrobiła furorę na ściance. Wtem weszła Agnieszka Hyży cała na biało

gr.title: Στην Αθήνα το Σάββατο Βενσάντ Κασέλ, Ρομέν Γαβράς και Εμιλι Ραταϊκόφσκι -Γιατί έρχονται πού θα βρεθούν
gr.description: Μαζί στην Αθήνα θα βρεθούν Ρομέν Γαβράς και Εμιλι Ραταϊκόφσκι με αφορμή την επίσημη πρεμιέρα της νέας ταινίας του σκηνοθέτη, «Θυσία» (Sacrifice). Σύμφωνα με πληροφορίες ο σκηνοθέτης Ρομέν Γαβράς, η σύντροφός του Έμιλι Ραταϊκόφσκι , αλλά και ο ηθοποιός Βενσάν Κασέλ αναμένεται να βρεθούν στην ελληνική πρωτεύουσα με αφορμή το κινηματογραφικό γεγονός, που αποτελεί την πρώτη αγγλόφωνη κινηματογραφική δουλειά του καταξιωμένου Ρομέν Γαβράς. Το Χόλιγουντ πάει στη Στέγη του Ιδρύματος Ωνάση Η ειδική προβολή θα πραγματοποιηθεί το προσεχές Σάββατο στις 19:30 στην εμβληματική Στέγη του Ιδρύματος Ωνάση, παρουσία πλήθους επώνυμων καλεσμένων από τον καλλιτεχνικό και επιχειρηματικό κόσμο. Ο γιος του θρυλικού Κώστα Γαβρά αναμένεται να ταξιδέψει στην Αθήνα ειδικά για την περίσταση και στο πλευρό του εικάζεται πως θα βρίσκεται η διάσημη σύντροφός του, το διεθνούς φήμης μοντέλο και επιχειρηματίας Έμιλι Ραταϊκόφσκι, η οποία όπως είναι φυσικό θα μαγνητίσει τα βλέμματα. Δείτε το τρέιλερ Μια εκρηκτική, σατιρική περιπέτεια Το «παρών» στην ελληνική πρωτεύουσα αναμένεται πως θα δώσει και ο κορυφαίος Γάλλος ηθοποιός Βενσάν Κασέλ, ο οποίος κρατά έναν από τους κεντρικούς ρόλους στην ταινία. Το «Sacrifice», που χαρακτηρίζεται ως μια εκρηκτική, σατιρική περιπέτεια, διαθέτει ένα εντυπωσιακό καστ στο οποίο συμμετέχουν επίσης οι Ανια Τέιλορ-Τζόι, Κρις Έβανς και Σάλμα Χάγιεκ. gr.title: «Μια Γυναίκα»: Κάνει πρεμιέρα στον Alpha με διπλό επεισόδιο
gr.description: Όταν η ζωή σου στερεί τα πάντα, μαθαίνεις να γίνεσαι τα πάντα! Η κοινωνική σειρά « Μια Γυναίκα » είναι μία ανθρώπινη ιστορία που έχει στο επίκεντρο τον αγώνα μιας γυναίκας που πρέπει να αντιμετωπίσει την ανέχεια και την εγκατάλειψη, προκειμένου να μεγαλώσει τα δυο μικρά παιδιά της. Στη σειρά παρουσιάζεται μια διαφορετική πλευρά της σύγχρονης γυναίκας. Η Μαρίνα είναι μια νέα γυναίκα που βιώνει την απώλεια μετά το θάνατο του συζύγου της και μένει μόνη με δυο παιδιά. Βρίσκεται μόνη χωρίς οικονομικούς πόρους και ανθρώπινη υποστήριξη. Είναι αναγκασμένη να βρει τρόπους και διεξόδους, να εργαστεί σε μια εχθρική κοινωνία και να εξασφαλίσει την επιβίωση της οικογένειάς της. Θα παλέψει με όλους και με όλα για να το πετύχει και να σταθεί στα πόδια της. Με διαρκή και επιτυχημένη επένδυση στην ποιοτική μυθοπλασία, με σειρές υψηλών προδιαγραφών παραγωγής και θεματολογία που αγγίζει ευαίσθητα κοινωνικά ζητήματα που αφορούν στη ζωή του τηλεθεατή, ο Alpha και τη φετινή σεζόν δίνει ηχηρό παρών. Μυθοπλασία Alpha: Ιστορίες που αγγίζουν κοινωνικά ζητήματα, γεννούν ερωτήματα και γίνονται αφορμή για συζήτηση. {https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P6I5ktiDlnM} «Μια Γυναίκα», πρεμιέρα την Τετάρτη 7 Οκτωβρίου στις 22:00, με διπλό επεισόδιο. #ΜΙΑ_ΓΥΝΑΙΚΑ #ΝΕΑ_ΣΕΙΡΑ #ALPHA

co.title: Esta es la carta completa con la que Bruce Mac Master renunció a la Andi: “Lo intentamos y no tuvimos éxito”
co.description: Bruce Mac Master presentó este jueves 1 de octubre su renuncia a la presidencia de la Asociación Nacional de Empresarios de Colombia (Andi), cargo que ocupó durante 12 años. En una carta dirigida a la Junta de Dirección General, los afiliados, los trabajadores de la organización y la opinión pública, explicó que tomó la decisión después de una “profunda reflexión” y en medio de las dificultades que, según afirmó, ha enfrentado el gremio en las últimas semanas. “He llegado a la conclusión de que me corresponde poner fin a mi ciclo al frente de la Asociación Nacional de Empresarios de Colombia, ANDI”, escribió Mac Master. El dirigente señaló que la decisión no fue sencilla, pues la intención de la organización era trabajar con el Gobierno para enfrentar los desafíos del país y promover el desarrollo económico. “Habíamos decidido ser parte activa de las soluciones que requiere el país y contribuir a liderarlas”, afirmó. Conozca más: Atención: Bruce Mac Master renuncia a la Andi tras 12 años al frente del principal gremio empresarial Uno de los apartados centrales de la carta está relacionado con las circunstancias que, según Mac Master, rodearon a la organización en las últimas semanas. El dirigente aseguró que se presentaron “circunstancias inesperadas y preocupantes” que hicieron más complejo el entorno de la Andi y que podrían tener efectos sobre sus afiliados y empleados.“Múltiples presiones han afectado su capacidad de actuar libremente y cumplir sus funciones con autonomía”, sostuvo Mac Master. Según explicó, frente a esa situación buscó actuar “con firmeza y prudencia”, privilegiando los canales institucionales y poniendo por encima de sus intereses personales los de la organización. El presidente saliente de la Andi también aseguró que la Junta de Dirección General y la Mesa Directiva participaron en los esfuerzos para encontrar una salida a la situación. El objetivo, dijo, era preservar la capacidad de interlocución de la organización con el Gobierno y mantener su independencia. “A pesar de lo anterior, todos esos intentos resultaron infructuosos”, afirmó. Y agregó: “Lo intentamos y no tuvimos éxito”. Mac Master explicó que su principal responsabilidad estaba con la organización, sus afiliados y sus trabajadores, por lo que consideró que su permanencia no debía convertirse en un factor que afectara el funcionamiento del gremio. “No puedo permitir que circunstancias externas a la Asociación terminen afectando a sus afiliados, sus libertades o su normal desempeño”, manifestó. También señaló que la situación podía afectar al equipo de trabajo y a la capacidad de la Andi para representar al sector productivo. En ese contexto, utilizó una expresión que resume una de sus preocupaciones sobre la coyuntura empresarial: “Hacer empresa en Colombia ha sido siempre un acto heroico. No tiene sentido agregar incertidumbre a una tarea esencial para una sociedad que necesita crecer aceleradamente para ampliar sus posibilidades”. Por eso, explicó que su retiro busca contribuir a que la institución pueda continuar funcionando. “Si mi retiro contribuye a proteger a la institución y a facilitar que pueda continuar desarrollando plenamente su misión, debo dar este paso”, escribió. En contexto: ¿Escala la tensión entre la Andi y el Gobierno? Coca-Cola sale de una cámara y otras tres empresas dejarían el gremio Mac Master también expresó su expectativa de que su salida permita recomponer la relación entre el Gobierno Nacional y el sector empresarial representado por la Andi. “Espero genuinamente que esta decisión contribuya también a recuperar el trabajo conjunto entre el Gobierno Nacional y el empresariado”, señaló. El objetivo, agregó, debe ser construir “un ambiente de estabilidad y confianza” para el sector productivo y para la comunidad que rodea a la organización. El dirigente vinculó además su decisión con la necesidad de preservar la autonomía de las instituciones y los contrapesos democráticos. “El país necesita instituciones fuertes y trabajo armónico en muchos frentes”, afirmó, antes de destacar que son necesarios “pesos y contrapesos que aseguren los límites que protegen la democracia”. En otro de los apartados más enfáticos de la carta, Mac Master rechazó que su salida pueda interpretarse como un abandono de sus convicciones. Recordó que durante su trayectoria al frente de la Andi enfrentó diferentes coyunturas y defendió al gremio, al sector productivo y a las instituciones. “La historia ha demostrado que he dado cada una de las luchas que me ha correspondido enfrentar”, escribió. Según el dirigente, cuando fue necesario defender a la Andi, al sector productivo, las instituciones, las libertades o la democracia, lo hizo “con determinación y sin eludir los costos personales”. Sobre su decisión de retirarse, anotó: “Es desde esa convicción, y no desde el cansancio ni desde la renuncia a mis principios, que tomo hoy esta decisión”. Mac Master también señaló que una de las principales lecciones que deja esta situación es que la defensa de una causa debe considerar sus efectos sobre terceros. “Ninguna convicción personal puede estar por encima de la responsabilidad de proteger una institución y a quienes hacen parte de ella”, afirmó. En el cierre de su carta, el dirigente expresó su gratitud con los empresarios afiliados, las juntas directivas, los órganos de dirección y el equipo de trabajo de la Andi. También reivindicó los 12 años que estuvo al frente de la organización. “Me retiro de la Presidencia de la Andi con enorme gratitud y con la convicción del deber cumplido”, afirmó. Añadió que termina esta etapa con la tranquilidad de haber actuado de acuerdo con sus convicciones y de haber defendido “el papel del empresariado en la sociedad”. Mac Master destacó especialmente a los trabajadores de la organización y aseguró que la Andi trasciende a quienes ocupan temporalmente sus cargos directivos. “La Andi es mucho más grande que cualquiera de las personas que temporalmente hemos tenido el privilegio de liderarla. Es una institución de Colombia y para Colombia”, sostuvo. in.title: Manipur CM felicitates Mirabai Chanu, Roshibina Devi for Asian Games silver medals
in.description: Digital Desk | Imphal, Oct 1 (IANS) Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh on Thursday felicitated ace weightlifter Saikhom Mirabai Chanu and Wushu player Naorem Roshibina Devi on their return to the state after winning silver medals at the ongoing Asian Games in Japan's Aichi-Nagoya. The Chief Minister congratulated the two athletes for their impressive performances and bringing laurels to Manipur and the country at the continental sporting event. During the felicitation, Chief Minister Singh expressed his desire to establish sports complexes in the rural areas of Manipur, saying that Imphal city is becoming increasingly congested. He added that such facilities would provide sportspersons with easier access to sports infrastructure. The Chief Minister said that if the law and order situation in the state improves, the state government would be able to increase the assistance provided to sportspersons who bring laurels to the state. Regarding the formation of more than one federation or association for a single discipline in Manipur, Chief Minister Singh said that this creates difficulties in the selection process of players for participation in national and international level competitions. The Chief Minister lauded the responsibilities undertaken by the local clubs and Civil Society Organisations who contribute significantly towards fulfilling the dreams of the young and successful sportspersons of the state. Chief Minister Singh maintained that the cash reward provided by the state government to medallists at the Asian Games has been enhanced. The new cash incentives have been fixed for gold, silver, bronze and participants at Rs 25 lakh, Rs 20 lakh, Rs 15 lakh, Rs 5 lakh respectively. Regarding the proposed establishment of the Weightlifting Sports Academy, the Chief Minister, after discussions with the concerned Minister and officials, said that a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) would soon be signed between the state government and the Academy. Chief Minister Singh also said that he would examine the matter regarding the promotion of Saikhom Mirabai Chanu. Saikhom Mirabai Chanu won a silver medal in the women's 48 kg category weightlifting and Naorem Roshibina Devi won a silver medal in the women's Sanda 60 kg category. After the felicitation, the two silver medallists expressed happiness at being received by Chief Minister Singh. They expressed pride in bringing laurels to the state and added that the love and support shown by the people of Manipur further encourages them in their future endeavour. The felicitation programme was attended by Youth Affairs and Sports (YAS) Minister Konthoujam Govindas Singh, Lamlai Assembly Constituency MLA Khongbantabam Ibomcha, Home Commissioner N. Ashok Kumar, YAS Director Mayengbam Veto Singh and parents of the two silver medalist, among others.

sg.title: Proya Claims Podium Fundamental Research Award at 2026 IFSCC
sg.description: Proya Also Named a Top 10 Finalist for the Podium Fundamental Research Award PERTH, Australia , Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Proya Cosmetics, a leading Chinese beauty company, has claimed the 2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award at the 36th Congress of the International Federation of Societies of Cosmetic Chemists (IFSCC) — a historic first for the company, with its research on "MGME1-Mediated Mitochondrial DNA Replication Homeostasis Regulates Skin Fibroblast Senescence via the cGAS-STING Pathway" selected from thousands of scientific papers submitted worldwide. In a second honor, a separate Proya paper was also named among this year's "IFSCC 2026 Top 10 Podium Fundamental Research Award" finalists. Presented at the Congress, held from September 28 to October 1 in Perth, Western Australia, the two awards mark Proya's second consecutive year of recognition on the IFSCC stage. Proya Cosmetics has become the first Chinese company to earn two awards at the same time at the IFSCC Congress. Song Yaling Receives the Podium Fundamental Research Award Proya, as China's leading listed beauty company, was also named a "Technical Gold Benefactor" this year, in recognition of its sustained contribution to cosmetic science R&D. IFSCC is often referred to as "the Nobel Prize of cosmetic science." This year's Congress, themed "Solving the Sustainable Beauty Equation," showcased frontier research from across the global cosmetic science community, accepting 76 papers for podium presentation and 749 for poster presentation in total. Proya Cosmetics had all 20 of its submitted works accepted, with four as podium presentations and 16 as posters. This marks the strongest showing in Proya's IFSCC history, both in the number of podium presentations and in the overall scale of accepted research, and sets a new record for the most podium presentations by a Chinese cosmetics company at a single IFSCC Congress. This year, Proya Cosmetics presented research on mitochondrial anti-aging, pigmentation mechanisms, AI-driven active ingredient screening, and sunscreen film structural engineering. Together, these studies span fundamental skin science, active ingredients, and formulation technology, reflecting the company's shift in recent years from pursuing standalone research breakthroughs to building a systematic R&D capability. The top-placed research was titled "MGME1-Mediated Mitochondrial DNA Replication Homeostasis Regulates Skin Fibroblast Aging via the cGAS-STING Pathway." It was honored as the sole "2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award", presented by Song Yaling of Proya's Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center. （left）Song Yaling delivered a podium presentation on mitochondrial anti-aging research at 2026 IFSCC Congress;（right）Feng Zhe delivered a podium presentation on mitochondria-related skin-whitening research at the 2026 IFSCC Congress Chronic, low-grade inflammation is widely considered one of the key drivers behind skin aging. This research found that declining function of the regulatory factor MGME1 disrupts mitochondrial DNA replication, causing mitochondrial DNA to leak abnormally into the cell's cytoplasm. That, in turn, activates the cGAS-STING inflammatory signaling pathway, accelerating fibroblast senescence and disrupting collagen balance in the skin. The findings reveal a previously unclear connection between MGME1-driven mitochondrial DNA replication and fibroblast inflammation and aging, opening up a new upstream direction for anti-aging research. The research is currently informing R&D and efficacy testing for Proya's Energy series and lays scientific groundwork for future anti-aging ingredient discovery. Mitochondria are increasingly becoming a central research focus within Proya's anti-aging program, from fundamental science through to product development. The second paper, named among the Top 10 "2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award" finalists was titled "Fibroblast Senescence Induced by Melanosome Internalization: Insights Into Inflammation, Mitochondrial Dysfunction, and Dermal Pigmentation," presented at the Congress by Feng Zhe of Proya's Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center. Stubborn dark spots aren't just a surface-level problem, and this research shows why. The study found that once dermal fibroblasts absorb melanosomes — the granules that carry skin pigment — it triggers cellular senescence, inflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction, which together drive visible pigmentation. Rather than focusing on the epidermis, as most pigmentation research does, this work looks deeper, into how melanin actually behaves and metabolizes within the dermis itself. That's what makes it possible to target the real biological root of stubborn, recurring dark spots, rather than just treating the surface. The research establishes a new mechanistic connection between pigmentation, inflammation, mitochondrial function, and cellular senescence — offering fresh scientific insight into how uneven skin tone and skin aging are linked and opening a new research direction for future ingredient and product development. At the same Congress, IFSCC also named Proya Cosmetics a Technical Gold Benefactor. The distinction is reserved for companies that have shown sustained, substantial investment in science and technology, and have actively helped advance the field of cosmetic science. Only three beauty companies worldwide currently hold this distinction. Mr. Robert McPherson, IFSCC President-Elect, remarked: "This shows the tremendous effort and scientific excellence taking place at Proya, and we're glad to see that shared with the international community. We also recognize that at the 2025 Congress, Proya's research was selected among the Top 10 podium presentations, which paved the way for Proya to become a Technical Gold Benefactor. That reflects not only Proya's continued support of IFSCC, but also its delivery of genuine technical excellence." At the Technical Gold Benefactor award ceremony: From left: Dr. Huang Hu, Proya Chief Scientist, Mr. Hou Juncheng, Proya Cosmetics Chairman, Dr. Isabelle Castiel, 2025-2026 IFSCC President, Mr. Robert McPherson, IFSCC President-Elect Proya Cosmetics Founder and Chairman Hou Juncheng said: "This honor recognizes not only Proya's longstanding commitment to scientific and technological innovation, but also the growing scientific strength of China's beauty industry. Scientific and technological innovation has always been the foundation of Proya's development and a core driver of our growth. As consumer needs become increasingly diverse and expectations for product performance continue to rise, we are steadily increasing our R&D investment, strengthening our global research network, bringing together scientific expertise and resources from around the world, and benchmarking ourselves against leading international standards. Looking ahead, we will remain equally committed to independent innovation and global collaboration. By competing internationally through stronger scientific capabilities, we aim to bring more original Chinese beauty technologies to the world and enable consumers everywhere to experience the scientific strength behind Chinese beauty." In recent years, Proya Cosmetics has steadily increased its R&D investment, building a global research system anchored by the Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center, the Shanghai R&D Center, and the Europe Innovation Center. Since 2020, R&D investment has grown nearly threefold, and the research team has expanded to nearly 400 people, more than half holding master's or doctoral degrees. As of June 2026, Proya held 332 patents in total — 154 invention patents, 26 utility model patents, and 152 design patents. But the more telling number isn't the scale of that investment, but rather how consistently Proya Cosmetics is now turning research into real products. Proya Cosmetics' progress at IFSCC tells a clear story. After winning the Top 10 Basic Research Award for its mitochondrial anti-aging research in 2025, the company returned this year claiming the Podium Fundamental Research Award for the first time, alongside being named a Top 10 finalist of the Podium Fundamental Research Award. These achievements reflect more than occasional standout results; they demonstrate a sustained commitment to original research and its consistent translation into tangible outcomes. Looking ahead, Proya Cosmetics will continue to deepen fundamental research in frontier fields such as skin science and life sciences, contributing more original technologies that can be validated and translated into practical applications to the global cosmetic science community. By strengthening its core scientific capabilities, the company aims to support the high-quality development of China's beauty industry and advance Chinese beauty innovation on the global stage. About Proya Cosmetics As a leading listed company specialized in the R&D, production, and sales of cosmetics in the domestic cosmetics industry, Proya Cosmetics Co., Ltd. (stock code: 603605) owns a diverse portfolio of brands including PROYA, TIMAGE, O&Relax, Flower Knows, HAPSODE, CORRECTORS, INSBAHA, Awaken Seeds, SINGULADERM, UZERO and ANYA. These brands cover a wide range of beauty product areas such as skincare, makeup, body and hair care, and high-efficacy skincare. In 2025, Proya Cosmetics reported revenue of RMB 10.597 billion, ranking first among Chinese cosmetics companies for three consecutive years. It is currently the only Chinese cosmetics company to achieve an annual revenue exceeding RMB 10 billion. Since its founding, Proya Cosmetics has consistently prioritized technology as its core driver, establishing the Longwu R&D Center in Hangzhou, the Shanghai R&D Center, and the Europe Innovation Center. We have forged partnerships with the world's top ten premium raw material suppliers, industry associations, and academic institutions, introduced world-class R&D equipment, and accelerated the development of new technologies, evolving into an innovative enterprise with robust core competitiveness. Facing global competition, Proya Cosmetics has established its "Double Ten" strategic vision — "To rank among the top ten in the global cosmetics industry within the next decade" — and is dedicated to becoming a world-class beauty company. The company strives to lead the high-quality development of domestic beauty products, foster healthy and sustainable growth in China's beauty industry, and serve as an industry benchmark that propels Chinese beauty brands into the global top tier. ph.title: Proya Claims Podium Fundamental Research Award at 2026 IFSCC
ph.description: Proya Also Named a Top 10 Finalist for the Podium Fundamental Research Award PERTH, Australia , Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Proya Cosmetics, a leading Chinese beauty company, has claimed the 2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award at the 36th Congress of the International Federation of Societies of Cosmetic Chemists (IFSCC) — a historic first for the company, with its research on "MGME1-Mediated Mitochondrial DNA Replication Homeostasis Regulates Skin Fibroblast Senescence via the cGAS-STING Pathway" selected from thousands of scientific papers submitted worldwide. In a second honor, a separate Proya paper was also named among this year's "IFSCC 2026 Top 10 Podium Fundamental Research Award" finalists. Presented at the Congress, held from September 28 to October 1 in Perth, Western Australia, the two awards mark Proya's second consecutive year of recognition on the IFSCC stage. Proya Cosmetics has become the first Chinese company to earn two awards at the same time at the IFSCC Congress. Song Yaling Receives the Podium Fundamental Research Award Proya, as China's leading listed beauty company, was also named a "Technical Gold Benefactor" this year, in recognition of its sustained contribution to cosmetic science R&D. IFSCC is often referred to as "the Nobel Prize of cosmetic science." This year's Congress, themed "Solving the Sustainable Beauty Equation," showcased frontier research from across the global cosmetic science community, accepting 76 papers for podium presentation and 749 for poster presentation in total. Proya Cosmetics had all 20 of its submitted works accepted, with four as podium presentations and 16 as posters. This marks the strongest showing in Proya's IFSCC history, both in the number of podium presentations and in the overall scale of accepted research, and sets a new record for the most podium presentations by a Chinese cosmetics company at a single IFSCC Congress. This year, Proya Cosmetics presented research on mitochondrial anti-aging, pigmentation mechanisms, AI-driven active ingredient screening, and sunscreen film structural engineering. Together, these studies span fundamental skin science, active ingredients, and formulation technology, reflecting the company's shift in recent years from pursuing standalone research breakthroughs to building a systematic R&D capability. The top-placed research was titled "MGME1-Mediated Mitochondrial DNA Replication Homeostasis Regulates Skin Fibroblast Aging via the cGAS-STING Pathway." It was honored as the sole "2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award", presented by Song Yaling of Proya's Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center. （left）Song Yaling delivered a podium presentation on mitochondrial anti-aging research at 2026 IFSCC Congress;（right）Feng Zhe delivered a podium presentation on mitochondria-related skin-whitening research at the 2026 IFSCC Congress Chronic, low-grade inflammation is widely considered one of the key drivers behind skin aging. This research found that declining function of the regulatory factor MGME1 disrupts mitochondrial DNA replication, causing mitochondrial DNA to leak abnormally into the cell's cytoplasm. That, in turn, activates the cGAS-STING inflammatory signaling pathway, accelerating fibroblast senescence and disrupting collagen balance in the skin. The findings reveal a previously unclear connection between MGME1-driven mitochondrial DNA replication and fibroblast inflammation and aging, opening up a new upstream direction for anti-aging research. The research is currently informing R&D and efficacy testing for Proya's Energy series and lays scientific groundwork for future anti-aging ingredient discovery. Mitochondria are increasingly becoming a central research focus within Proya's anti-aging program, from fundamental science through to product development. The second paper, named among the Top 10 "2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award" finalists was titled "Fibroblast Senescence Induced by Melanosome Internalization: Insights Into Inflammation, Mitochondrial Dysfunction, and Dermal Pigmentation," presented at the Congress by Feng Zhe of Proya's Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center. Stubborn dark spots aren't just a surface-level problem, and this research shows why. The study found that once dermal fibroblasts absorb melanosomes — the granules that carry skin pigment — it triggers cellular senescence, inflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction, which together drive visible pigmentation. Rather than focusing on the epidermis, as most pigmentation research does, this work looks deeper, into how melanin actually behaves and metabolizes within the dermis itself. That's what makes it possible to target the real biological root of stubborn, recurring dark spots, rather than just treating the surface. The research establishes a new mechanistic connection between pigmentation, inflammation, mitochondrial function, and cellular senescence — offering fresh scientific insight into how uneven skin tone and skin aging are linked and opening a new research direction for future ingredient and product development. At the same Congress, IFSCC also named Proya Cosmetics a Technical Gold Benefactor. The distinction is reserved for companies that have shown sustained, substantial investment in science and technology, and have actively helped advance the field of cosmetic science. Only three beauty companies worldwide currently hold this distinction. Mr. Robert McPherson, IFSCC President-Elect, remarked: "This shows the tremendous effort and scientific excellence taking place at Proya, and we're glad to see that shared with the international community. We also recognize that at the 2025 Congress, Proya's research was selected among the Top 10 podium presentations, which paved the way for Proya to become a Technical Gold Benefactor. That reflects not only Proya's continued support of IFSCC, but also its delivery of genuine technical excellence." At the Technical Gold Benefactor award ceremony: From left: Dr. Huang Hu, Proya Chief Scientist, Mr. Hou Juncheng, Proya Cosmetics Chairman, Dr. Isabelle Castiel, 2025-2026 IFSCC President, Mr. Robert McPherson, IFSCC President-Elect Proya Cosmetics Founder and Chairman Hou Juncheng said: "This honor recognizes not only Proya's longstanding commitment to scientific and technological innovation, but also the growing scientific strength of China's beauty industry. Scientific and technological innovation has always been the foundation of Proya's development and a core driver of our growth. As consumer needs become increasingly diverse and expectations for product performance continue to rise, we are steadily increasing our R&D investment, strengthening our global research network, bringing together scientific expertise and resources from around the world, and benchmarking ourselves against leading international standards. Looking ahead, we will remain equally committed to independent innovation and global collaboration. By competing internationally through stronger scientific capabilities, we aim to bring more original Chinese beauty technologies to the world and enable consumers everywhere to experience the scientific strength behind Chinese beauty." In recent years, Proya Cosmetics has steadily increased its R&D investment, building a global research system anchored by the Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center, the Shanghai R&D Center, and the Europe Innovation Center. Since 2020, R&D investment has grown nearly threefold, and the research team has expanded to nearly 400 people, more than half holding master's or doctoral degrees. As of June 2026, Proya held 332 patents in total — 154 invention patents, 26 utility model patents, and 152 design patents. But the more telling number isn't the scale of that investment, but rather how consistently Proya Cosmetics is now turning research into real products. Proya Cosmetics' progress at IFSCC tells a clear story. After winning the Top 10 Basic Research Award for its mitochondrial anti-aging research in 2025, the company returned this year claiming the Podium Fundamental Research Award for the first time, alongside being named a Top 10 finalist of the Podium Fundamental Research Award. These achievements reflect more than occasional standout results; they demonstrate a sustained commitment to original research and its consistent translation into tangible outcomes. Looking ahead, Proya Cosmetics will continue to deepen fundamental research in frontier fields such as skin science and life sciences, contributing more original technologies that can be validated and translated into practical applications to the global cosmetic science community. By strengthening its core scientific capabilities, the company aims to support the high-quality development of China's beauty industry and advance Chinese beauty innovation on the global stage. About Proya Cosmetics As a leading listed company specialized in the R&D, production, and sales of cosmetics in the domestic cosmetics industry, Proya Cosmetics Co., Ltd. (stock code: 603605) owns a diverse portfolio of brands including PROYA, TIMAGE, O&Relax, Flower Knows, HAPSODE, CORRECTORS, INSBAHA, Awaken Seeds, SINGULADERM, UZERO and ANYA. These brands cover a wide range of beauty product areas such as skincare, makeup, body and hair care, and high-efficacy skincare. In 2025, Proya Cosmetics reported revenue of RMB 10.597 billion, ranking first among Chinese cosmetics companies for three consecutive years. It is currently the only Chinese cosmetics company to achieve an annual revenue exceeding RMB 10 billion. Since its founding, Proya Cosmetics has consistently prioritized technology as its core driver, establishing the Longwu R&D Center in Hangzhou, the Shanghai R&D Center, and the Europe Innovation Center. We have forged partnerships with the world's top ten premium raw material suppliers, industry associations, and academic institutions, introduced world-class R&D equipment, and accelerated the development of new technologies, evolving into an innovative enterprise with robust core competitiveness. Facing global competition, Proya Cosmetics has established its "Double Ten" strategic vision — "To rank among the top ten in the global cosmetics industry within the next decade" — and is dedicated to becoming a world-class beauty company. The company strives to lead the high-quality development of domestic beauty products, foster healthy and sustainable growth in China's beauty industry, and serve as an industry benchmark that propels Chinese beauty brands into the global top tier. pk.title: Proya Claims Podium Fundamental Research Award at 2026 IFSCC
pk.description: Proya Also Named a Top 10 Finalist for the Podium Fundamental Research Award PERTH, Australia , Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Proya Cosmetics, a leading Chinese beauty company, has claimed the 2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award at the 36th Congress of the International Federation of Societies of Cosmetic Chemists (IFSCC) — a historic first for the company, with its research on "MGME1-Mediated Mitochondrial DNA Replication Homeostasis Regulates Skin Fibroblast Senescence via the cGAS-STING Pathway" selected from thousands of scientific papers submitted worldwide. In a second honor, a separate Proya paper was also named among this year's "IFSCC 2026 Top 10 Podium Fundamental Research Award" finalists. Presented at the Congress, held from September 28 to October 1 in Perth, Western Australia, the two awards mark Proya's second consecutive year of recognition on the IFSCC stage. Proya Cosmetics has become the first Chinese company to earn two awards at the same time at the IFSCC Congress. Song Yaling Receives the Podium Fundamental Research Award Proya, as China's leading listed beauty company, was also named a "Technical Gold Benefactor" this year, in recognition of its sustained contribution to cosmetic science R&D. IFSCC is often referred to as "the Nobel Prize of cosmetic science." This year's Congress, themed "Solving the Sustainable Beauty Equation," showcased frontier research from across the global cosmetic science community, accepting 76 papers for podium presentation and 749 for poster presentation in total. Proya Cosmetics had all 20 of its submitted works accepted, with four as podium presentations and 16 as posters. This marks the strongest showing in Proya's IFSCC history, both in the number of podium presentations and in the overall scale of accepted research, and sets a new record for the most podium presentations by a Chinese cosmetics company at a single IFSCC Congress. This year, Proya Cosmetics presented research on mitochondrial anti-aging, pigmentation mechanisms, AI-driven active ingredient screening, and sunscreen film structural engineering. Together, these studies span fundamental skin science, active ingredients, and formulation technology, reflecting the company's shift in recent years from pursuing standalone research breakthroughs to building a systematic R&D capability. The top-placed research was titled "MGME1-Mediated Mitochondrial DNA Replication Homeostasis Regulates Skin Fibroblast Aging via the cGAS-STING Pathway." It was honored as the sole "2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award", presented by Song Yaling of Proya's Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center. （left）Song Yaling delivered a podium presentation on mitochondrial anti-aging research at 2026 IFSCC Congress;（right）Feng Zhe delivered a podium presentation on mitochondria-related skin-whitening research at the 2026 IFSCC Congress Chronic, low-grade inflammation is widely considered one of the key drivers behind skin aging. This research found that declining function of the regulatory factor MGME1 disrupts mitochondrial DNA replication, causing mitochondrial DNA to leak abnormally into the cell's cytoplasm. That, in turn, activates the cGAS-STING inflammatory signaling pathway, accelerating fibroblast senescence and disrupting collagen balance in the skin. The findings reveal a previously unclear connection between MGME1-driven mitochondrial DNA replication and fibroblast inflammation and aging, opening up a new upstream direction for anti-aging research. The research is currently informing R&D and efficacy testing for Proya's Energy series and lays scientific groundwork for future anti-aging ingredient discovery. Mitochondria are increasingly becoming a central research focus within Proya's anti-aging program, from fundamental science through to product development. The second paper, named among the Top 10 "2026 IFSCC Podium Fundamental Research Award" finalists was titled "Fibroblast Senescence Induced by Melanosome Internalization: Insights Into Inflammation, Mitochondrial Dysfunction, and Dermal Pigmentation," presented at the Congress by Feng Zhe of Proya's Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center. Stubborn dark spots aren't just a surface-level problem, and this research shows why. The study found that once dermal fibroblasts absorb melanosomes — the granules that carry skin pigment — it triggers cellular senescence, inflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction, which together drive visible pigmentation. Rather than focusing on the epidermis, as most pigmentation research does, this work looks deeper, into how melanin actually behaves and metabolizes within the dermis itself. That's what makes it possible to target the real biological root of stubborn, recurring dark spots, rather than just treating the surface. The research establishes a new mechanistic connection between pigmentation, inflammation, mitochondrial function, and cellular senescence — offering fresh scientific insight into how uneven skin tone and skin aging are linked and opening a new research direction for future ingredient and product development. At the same Congress, IFSCC also named Proya Cosmetics a Technical Gold Benefactor. The distinction is reserved for companies that have shown sustained, substantial investment in science and technology, and have actively helped advance the field of cosmetic science. Only three beauty companies worldwide currently hold this distinction. Mr. Robert McPherson, IFSCC President-Elect, remarked: "This shows the tremendous effort and scientific excellence taking place at Proya, and we're glad to see that shared with the international community. We also recognize that at the 2025 Congress, Proya's research was selected among the Top 10 podium presentations, which paved the way for Proya to become a Technical Gold Benefactor. That reflects not only Proya's continued support of IFSCC, but also its delivery of genuine technical excellence." At the Technical Gold Benefactor award ceremony: From left: Dr. Huang Hu, Proya Chief Scientist, Mr. Hou Juncheng, Proya Cosmetics Chairman, Dr. Isabelle Castiel, 2025-2026 IFSCC President, Mr. Robert McPherson, IFSCC President-Elect Proya Cosmetics Founder and Chairman Hou Juncheng said: "This honor recognizes not only Proya's longstanding commitment to scientific and technological innovation, but also the growing scientific strength of China's beauty industry. Scientific and technological innovation has always been the foundation of Proya's development and a core driver of our growth. As consumer needs become increasingly diverse and expectations for product performance continue to rise, we are steadily increasing our R&D investment, strengthening our global research network, bringing together scientific expertise and resources from around the world, and benchmarking ourselves against leading international standards. Looking ahead, we will remain equally committed to independent innovation and global collaboration. By competing internationally through stronger scientific capabilities, we aim to bring more original Chinese beauty technologies to the world and enable consumers everywhere to experience the scientific strength behind Chinese beauty." In recent years, Proya Cosmetics has steadily increased its R&D investment, building a global research system anchored by the Hangzhou Longwu R&D Center, the Shanghai R&D Center, and the Europe Innovation Center. Since 2020, R&D investment has grown nearly threefold, and the research team has expanded to nearly 400 people, more than half holding master's or doctoral degrees. As of June 2026, Proya held 332 patents in total — 154 invention patents, 26 utility model patents, and 152 design patents. But the more telling number isn't the scale of that investment, but rather how consistently Proya Cosmetics is now turning research into real products. Proya Cosmetics' progress at IFSCC tells a clear story. After winning the Top 10 Basic Research Award for its mitochondrial anti-aging research in 2025, the company returned this year claiming the Podium Fundamental Research Award for the first time, alongside being named a Top 10 finalist of the Podium Fundamental Research Award. These achievements reflect more than occasional standout results; they demonstrate a sustained commitment to original research and its consistent translation into tangible outcomes. Looking ahead, Proya Cosmetics will continue to deepen fundamental research in frontier fields such as skin science and life sciences, contributing more original technologies that can be validated and translated into practical applications to the global cosmetic science community. By strengthening its core scientific capabilities, the company aims to support the high-quality development of China's beauty industry and advance Chinese beauty innovation on the global stage. About Proya Cosmetics As a leading listed company specialized in the R&D, production, and sales of cosmetics in the domestic cosmetics industry, Proya Cosmetics Co., Ltd. (stock code: 603605) owns a diverse portfolio of brands including PROYA, TIMAGE, O&Relax, Flower Knows, HAPSODE, CORRECTORS, INSBAHA, Awaken Seeds, SINGULADERM, UZERO and ANYA. These brands cover a wide range of beauty product areas such as skincare, makeup, body and hair care, and high-efficacy skincare. In 2025, Proya Cosmetics reported revenue of RMB 10.597 billion, ranking first among Chinese cosmetics companies for three consecutive years. It is currently the only Chinese cosmetics company to achieve an annual revenue exceeding RMB 10 billion. Since its founding, Proya Cosmetics has consistently prioritized technology as its core driver, establishing the Longwu R&D Center in Hangzhou, the Shanghai R&D Center, and the Europe Innovation Center. We have forged partnerships with the world's top ten premium raw material suppliers, industry associations, and academic institutions, introduced world-class R&D equipment, and accelerated the development of new technologies, evolving into an innovative enterprise with robust core competitiveness. Facing global competition, Proya Cosmetics has established its "Double Ten" strategic vision — "To rank among the top ten in the global cosmetics industry within the next decade" — and is dedicated to becoming a world-class beauty company. The company strives to lead the high-quality development of domestic beauty products, foster healthy and sustainable growth in China's beauty industry, and serve as an industry benchmark that propels Chinese beauty brands into the global top tier. ae.title: Gable Guardians kicks off October Halloween event with 20,000 SKR and 200,000 PLAY on the line
ae.description: In Brief:The Halloween event in Gable Guardians (official site) began Oct. 1 and continues until Oct. 31 (UTC), offering a pool of 20,000 $SKR and 200,000 $PLAY.The event NPC is Morwen the Lantern Witch. Pumpkin King and the rarer Silly Halloween spawn on combat maps in Zones 2 through 8.To take part, players need a Web3 account, a gargoyle of their own at level 10 or above, and a Halloween pact paid for in GABLE.A Halloween event is now live in Gable Guardians, with 20,000 $SKR and 200,000 $PLAY to be distributed over October. For the occasion, the Solana MMORPG added a new NPC, Morwen the Lantern Witch, who appears in Runar City and its four elemental cities.The team announced the launch on X: "Our Halloween event has already started." Our Halloween event has already startedGable GuardiansView on X ↗ The event runs from Oct. 1 to Oct. 31, UTC. Players have until Nov. 2 to claim.How rewards are distributedThe game's documentation says 85% of the pool is paid out across 31 daily budgets. The remaining 15% is kept in reserve as a bonus reward on Oct. 31.Each day from 00:10 UTC, after the settlement is verified, players can claim the token reward from the day before. A new ritual unlocks at the same time.A ritual has several steps. Players must defeat 150 eligible PvE enemies and claim the combat mission, complete the 60-minute active connection mission, and gather at least five candy points and one Black Candle. After that, they go to Morwen and pick SKR, PLAY, an altar item or a candy offering to the Fox.Every wallet can complete one ritual per UTC day. The cap applies across all of that wallet's characters and devices.GABLE-priced pactsMorwen's Samhain Pact went on sale Sept. 25. It comes in three tiers, each priced in GABLE at a dollar equivalent.At the equivalent of $1, the Basic pact keeps base drop rates. The $5 Standard tier gives a 10% relative boost to common drops and a 10% EXP bonus, plus five HP and five SP pumpkins every day. The $10 Premium tier raises the relative drop boost to 20% and the EXP bonus to 25%, and hands out 10 HP and 10 SP pumpkins daily.According to the documentation, the higher tiers improve HP/SP pumpkin and candy collection, "not whistles, seeds or rare scales."Bosses and candyThroughout October, Pumpkin King and Silly Halloween spawn on a daily schedule. A Samhain Whistle also lets players summon them.The ritual system runs on candy. Soul Candy, Spiced Candy and Black Candle are soulbound, while Blue Candy is tradable. Morwen's altar offers items with daily stock limits. One example is Ember of Growth, priced at eight candy points, with 1,000 units of daily stock and a cap of 31 per wallet.HP Pumpkin, SP Pumpkin and Lantern Seed are among the other event items.The Fox community pactA separate community pact is run by the Fox. Its GABLE target was fixed once at the start of October at the GABLE equivalent of 3 SOL, and there is a separate candy target as well.The rules state: "All contributions are final and non-refundable."Last-day bonusesThe 15% reserve unlocks on Oct. 31. That same day, pact holders receive an additional 50 percentage points of EXP, and the relative drop chance for HP/SP pumpkins rises by 10%.Nov. 1 and 2 bring no new Halloween drops, rituals, pass bonuses or Fox contributions. In those two days, players can still claim their October rewards and swap remaining materials for whatever altar stock is still available.BackgroundGable Guardians is playable on the web and designed for Solana Mobile hardware, including Seeker and PlaySolana's PSG1, with an Android version also on offer. Gargoyles, weapons, armor and skills are NFTs. The game pays rewards in PLAY, SKR, GABLE, SOL and gold-backed GOLD.Earlier in 2026, a Seeker mob that drops $SKR on defeat was added to the game. On X, the team said Gable Guardians won both the Play Solana Matrix Hackathon and the Bags Hackathon.Morwen departs at 00:00 UTC on Nov. 3. Any unclaimed rewards and unused event materials expire then, and leftover funds remain with the game for future events.

ae.title: World’s tallest gold bar draws visitors at Sharjah jewellery show
ae.description: Sharjah: Visitors to the 58th Watch & Jewellery Middle East Show at Expo Centre Sharjah are turning their attention to one of the exhibition’s most striking displays - the world’s tallest gold bar, which holds an official Guinness World Records title and is showcased by BTC. The gold bar measures 2.12 metres (6 feet 11.5 inches), making it the world’s tallest gold bar, according to the official Guinness World Records certificate. Designed in the form of a golden ruler, the record-breaking piece combines its exceptional dimensions with a distinctive visual presentation, allowing visitors to engage directly with the display. The gold bar also offers visitors an interactive experience through the "Measure Your Height in Gold” concept. Visitors can stand beside the bar, compare their height with its towering length, and take photographs next to it. Displayed vertically on a dedicated platform featuring the exhibition’s branding, the gold bar is accompanied by the Guinness World Records certificate, which documents the achievement and officially identifies the bar as the record holder. Its presence at the exhibition offers a distinctive approach to showcasing gold, combining the value of the precious metal with innovative design and visual appeal. Its exceptional height allows visitors to experience a gold piece on an unusual scale and to interact with it directly. BTC’s participation in the record-breaking piece forms part of the Watch & Jewellery Middle East Show, taking place at Expo Centre Sharjah from 30 September to 4 October 2026. The exhibition features more than 500 brands from 19 countries, spanning an area exceeding 30,000 square metres, alongside five international pavilions from Hong Kong, India, Italy, Singapore and Thailand. With a history spanning more than five decades, the exhibition continues to bring together jewellery houses, brands, designers, manufacturers, buyers and sector professionals, while showcasing the latest designs and collections featuring gold, diamonds, precious gemstones and watches.

ae.title: Sugar Rush Defense Revealed by Nakamoto Games, but Launch Timing Remains Unannounced
ae.description: In Brief:Nakamoto Games (official site) used a post on X, accompanied by a gameplay video, to unveil Sugar Rush Defense, the studio's own spin on the tower defense genre.According to the studio, the game centers on "quick action, endless replayability," though it did not provide a release date, a list of platforms or any information about how the NAKA token might be used.The game becomes part of Nakamoto Games' 2026 slate, which the studio has framed as "Web2-first for mass adoption" while treating Web3 as optional.Nakamoto Games has revealed a new tower defense title called Sugar Rush Defense, sharing a gameplay clip on X."SUGAR RUSH DEFENSE IS COMING," the studio posted. "Fast. Strategic. Addictive." SUGAR RUSH DEFENSE IS COMING.Fast. Strategic. Addictive.Our take on tower defensem built for quick action, endless replayability, and that “ONE MORE ROUND” feeling. WATCH THE GAMEPLAY. GET READY.Nakamoto.GamesView on X ↗ No launch date was given in the announcement. The studio also left open which platforms will carry the game and whether the NAKA token will play any role.What the studio saidRather than listing features, the reveal leaned on the game's pace. Nakamoto Games called it "Our take on tower defensem built for quick action, endless replayability, and that “ONE MORE ROUND” feeling."Two calls to action closed out the post: "WATCH THE GAMEPLAY." and "GET READY."So far, the studio has said nothing about monetization, tournaments, leaderboards or rewards. Beyond the X post, a search of the open web found no dedicated product page, store listing or press material for the game.Where it fitsThe game belongs to a release plan that Nakamoto Games outlined at the beginning of the year. In a post titled "NAKA 2026 Strategic Vision," the studio stated: "NAKA is evolving into a community-driven gaming ecosystem where players shape games, competitions, and rewards. Web2-first for mass adoption. Web3 optional for ownership and earning."That post also named "Communities, tournaments, leaderboards, and social play" as components of the platform.Most of the studio's catalog consists of short, casual games, and a tower defense title designed around quick matches matches that approach. Whether Sugar Rush Defense will connect to the studio's tournament or reward systems has not been confirmed.BackgroundAlongside the NAKA token, Nakamoto Games operates a portfolio of browser and mobile games. Under its 2026 strategy, conventional player acquisition comes first, while wallets and token features are offered as optional add-ons.Tower defense has been a fixture of casual and mobile gaming for years. Its draw comes from short sessions and repeat play, which is exactly what Nakamoto Games is pitching here.At this point, players have just a trailer and a single-line promise from the studio: "that “ONE MORE ROUND” feeling."

sa.title: كوميدي ومغامرة وأنيميشن.. السينمات تستقبل 4 أفلام جديدة اليوم
sa.description: تستقبل السينمات السعودية خلال عطلة هذا الأسبوع 4 أفلام جديدة ، ضمن مجموعة الأفلام التي يتم عرضها في نهاية كل أسبوع في دور العرض، وتتنوع الأعمال المعروضة بين ا لكوميدي ومغامرة والأنيميشن . The Crystal Planet تبدأ السينمات اليوم عرض فيلم " The Crystal Planet" الذي تدور أحداثه حول عالم جرى استعماره حديثًا، حيث تتعرف الطفلة ريا، البالغة من العمر 11 عامًا، إلى صغير يشبه الديناصور يُدعى بورجي، بعدما فرّقه وحش متحوّل عن والدته. وتنطلق ريا في رحلة لإعادته إليها، قبل أن تتحول المهمة إلى مغامرة خطيرة حين يعترض طريقهما حاكم قاسٍ يسعى لاستغلال قدرات بورجي الفريدة لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية، لتصبح الصداقة والشجاعة وسيلتهما لحماية كل ما يحبانه. الفيلم بطولة جيرمي آيرونز، فانيسا ريدجريف، مايكل يورك، جيسيكا بون، باستيان أنطونيو فوينتيس، وجوش موريسون، ومن إخراج وتأليف أرسين أنطون أوستويتش. Gator Face كما تعرض السينمات فيلم " Gator Face" وتدور أحداث الفيلم حول مجموعة من الأصدقاء تنقلب رحلتهم إلى فلوريدا إلى كابوس دموي، بعدما تقطعت بهم السبل في منطقة نائية وسط المستنقعات، ليكتشفوا وجود طائفة قاتلة تؤمن بتقديم قرابين بشرية لإله على هيئة تمساح. وبين مطاردة منفذ مقنّع يعمل لصالح الجماعة، وخطر الكائنات المفترسة الكامنة في الظلام، يجد الأصدقاء أنفسهم في صراع يائس من أجل النجاة. الفيلم تأليف وإخراج بادريج رينولدز وبطولة إيلي شاديكس، أماريا ديون، نيكولاس كولاسينسكي، بارون ريجان، تابيثا براونستون، وإيان سميث. Digger فيلم " Digger" تجدونه اليوم في صالات السينما، وهو دراما كوميدية تدور حول الرجل الأقوى في العالم، الذي يجد نفسه في سباق محموم لإثبات أنه قادر على إنقاذ البشرية، بعد أن يتسبب في كارثة تهدد بتدمير كل شيء. ومع تصاعد الأزمة، ينطلق في مهمة محفوفة بالمخاطر لاستعادة السيطرة على الموقف، بينما يحاول إقناع الجميع بأنه المنقذ الوحيد القادر على إصلاح ما أفسده قبل فوات الأوان. من إخراج أليخاندرو جونزاليس إناريتو، وسيناريو ألكسندر دينيلاريس ونيكولاس جياكوبون، وبطولة توم كروز، ريز أحمد، روبرت جون بورك، كينتون كريج، إيما دارسي، وآر. إيه. دونيلي. Charlie Harper أما فيلم " Charlie Harper" يعرض اليوم في صالات السينما وتدور قصته حول هاربر وتشارلي حيث يحاولان بناء حياة مشتركة، بينما تسعى هاربر إلى شق طريقها المهني وتحقيق حلمها بالعمل طاهية، في الوقت الذي يشعر فيه تشارلي بأنه عالق وغير قادر على التقدم. ومع تصاعد الضغوط والخلافات التي تواجه علاقتهما، يتمسك الاثنان بحبهما ويحاولان إثبات أن ما يجمعهما أقوى من العقبات التي تقف في طريقهما. الفيلم من تأليف وإخراج توم دين وبطولة نيك روبينسون، وإيمليا جونز، ونيكولاس سيريلو، وجيسيكا بلاكمور، وفيرجينيا تاكر، وجاكوان مونرو هندرسون.

za.title: Number Of The Day | R16,60 | 01 October 2026
za.description: Number Of The Day | R16,60 | 01 October 2026 Vusi.Bafetane Thu, 10/01/2026 - 20:19 A Strong Rand Is A Buffer, Not A Shield For much of 2026, South Africans had an unusual piece of good news sitting quietly behind some very bad global headlines: the rand was holding up. That resilience mattered. A stronger currency cannot stop an oil shock, erase geopolitical risk or make imported goods cheap overnight, but it can soften the blow. When the rand buys more dollars, the country needs fewer rands to pay for goods priced internationally. When it weakens, that protection starts disappearing. The move through R16.60/$ is therefore important for a reason bigger than the number itself. The exchange rate is part of South Africa's inflation defence The South African Reserve Bank has repeatedly pointed to the rand's resilience as one reason import-price pressure remained relatively contained during 2026. Its September Monetary Policy Committee statement noted that the currency had helped keep import prices in check even while fuel and services inflation remained elevated. That is the part of exchange-rate movements that can feel invisible until the direction changes. South Africa imports large quantities of goods priced in foreign currency, including oil. When the rand weakens, the same dollar-priced barrel becomes more expensive in rand terms before it even enters the rest of the pricing chain. The episode captures that mechanism clearly. Higher imported fuel costs can move into farming, transport and logistics before eventually reaching consumers through the prices of goods on shelves. The Reserve Bank's latest Quarterly Bulletin makes the importance of that buffer even clearer. It found that the stronger rand had partly softened the domestic effect of sharply higher international energy prices during 2026. A weaker currency does not automatically produce an immediate price spike. Businesses hedge currency exposure, contracts differ, inventories were bought at earlier prices, and companies do not always pass every cost increase directly to customers. But the direction of pressure changes. Sometimes the story is happening somewhere else It is tempting to treat every fall in the rand as a referendum on South Africa. That can be misleading. On 1 October, the US dollar strengthened broadly as global government bonds sold off and US Treasury yields climbed to levels not seen since 2002. Reuters reported that the pressure was not confined to South Africa, with inflation fears and higher borrowing costs driving significant moves across global markets. That matters because investors constantly compare opportunities. If relatively safe US government debt suddenly offers significantly higher returns, some investors have less reason to hold assets in emerging markets. The result can be pressure on currencies such as the rand even when the immediate trigger is thousands of kilometres away. South African economic data on the day was not uniformly negative either. Reuters reported that manufacturing sentiment had improved and vehicle sales remained resilient, while the stronger dollar still weighed on the rand. Currency movements rarely tell one clean story. Resilience can be lost faster than it was built This is why R16.60/$ matters without needing to become a catastrophe headline. The episode itself makes the distinction. The rand is weaker than it was at the end of August, but Gareth Edwards and Francis Herd also note that its broader performance had remained relatively strong before the latest move. The lesson is not that a currency has suddenly failed. It is that resilience is conditional. A strong exchange rate can provide South Africa with breathing room against global shocks. It can reduce some import costs and soften inflation pressure. But it cannot permanently insulate an open economy from an oil shock, higher global interest rates, a stronger dollar or investors moving towards safer assets. The number to watch is R16.60. The bigger story is how quickly a useful economic buffer can thin when the global environment turns. References Number of the Day, 01 October 2026 episode transcript. za.title: Botswana, Lesotho Mark 60 Years Independence
za.description: As Botswana celebrates her 60 years independence on Wednesday, Lesotho gears for her own golden Jubilee independance as well on Sunday. The two sister countries are set to be marking decades of peace, stability and governance after gaining freedom from the British Colonial rule that is September 30, 1966 for Botswana and October 4, 1966 for the Mountain Kingdom respectively. In an interview with the Agency on Wednesday, the Coordinator of Lesotho at 60 under the Ministry of Tourism, Sports, Arts and Culture, Mrs. ‘Mabasia Shano explained the committee is fully aware of the aforementioned scenarios between two sister countries sharing a lot in common including independence month and year. Therefore, she wished Batswana a happy independence, urging Basotho to see this day as a warm up ahead of Basotho’s special day on Sunday that is October 04, whereby special activities of the day will include demonstration and performance of 60 years song. She stated that messages of the song are to be centred around the 60 years journey, adding it is expected that different artists from traditional ones to hip-hop amongst others will come together and showcase their art in line with theme song. Mrs. Shano also informed the nation collectively, individually and otherwise to also continue celebrations beyond October 04, stating there are other activities lined up and they include helping districts to make sustainable projects that will remain as legacies beyond 60 years. “Let us go and enjoy the milestone, afterwards we will unveil each district proposals and plans for such projects so that we are aware how each district intendeds to hold this legacy going forward.” In another story, she stipulated that their plan is also to initiate at some point a joint celebration as time goes by between Lesotho and Botswana, expressing hope the idea will be welcomed so that two nations, one way or the other engage on exchange. Both countries are members of Southern African Development Community Countries (SADC), aspiring to foster peace and security of their nations as well as United Nations (UN) with the intention to also forge path for development in their respective countries in areas of economy and others. Over and above that, Lesotho and Botswana are also working together with regard to Memorundum of Understanding (MoU) on water. Distributed by APO Group on behalf of Government of Lesotho.

dz.title: الجائزة الوطنية للصناعة التقليدية والحرف : إيداع ما يقارب 780 منتوجا حرفيا
dz.description: ثقافة : أشرفت وزيرة السياحة والصناعة التقليدية, حورية مداحي, على اجتماع مع أعضاء اللجنة الوطنية للجائزة الوطنية للصناعة التقليدية والحرف لطبعة 2026, حيث تم الكشف عن إيداع ما يقارب 780 منتوجا حرفيا, حسبما أفاد به بيان للوزارة. وأوضح المصدر ذاته, أن رئيس اللجنة استعرض رفقة الأعضاء حصيلة المشاركة المسجلة إلى غاية هذا التاريخ, والتي عرفت تفاعلا من طرف الحرفيين على مستوى مختلف الولايات من خلال "إيداع ما يقارب 780 منتوجا حرفيا, مع توقع ارتفاع هذا العدد مع استكمال عملية تجميع المنتجات على مستوى الولايات المكلفة بحصرها, تمهيدا لانطلاق عملية الانتقاء الجهوي". وبالمناسبة, أكد أعضاء اللجنة "استعدادهم لتسخير خبراتهم وتجاربهم, كل حسب اختصاصه وموقع تمثيله القطاعي, للمساهمة في عملية انتقاء موضوعية ومدروسة لأفضل المنتجات , وفق الشروط والمعايير المعمول بها, بما يضمن تحقيق الأهداف المتوخاة من تنظيم هذه الجائزة الوطنية سنويا". وفي هذا الإطار, أكدت الوزيرة أن الجائزة الوطنية للصناعة التقليدية والحرف تشكل "محطة هامة لتشجيع الإبداع والتميز والابتكار في مجال الصناعة التقليدية الفنية, وإبراز المنتجات الجزائرية التي تعكس أصالة وثراء التراث الحرفي الوطني, مع الحرص على أن تتجاوز الجائزة البعد التنافسي لتصبح آلية لتثمين الحرفيين ومنتجاتهم ومرافقتهم في مسار التطوير والتميز". كما شددت على أهمية "التثمين الإعلامي والترويج للمنتجات المشاركة والمتوجة عبر مختلف الوسائط والمنصات الإعلامية, بما يسمح بالتعريف بالإبداعات الحرفية الجزائرية وإبراز قيمتها الثقافية والاقتصادية, إلى جانب ضرورة مرافقة الحرفيين الذين يبلغون المراحل المتقدمة من المنافسة, والمتوجين في مختلف التخصصات". في هذا السياق, تم التأكيد على "أهمية مواصلة التنسيق مع قطاع التكوين والتعليم المهنيين, في إطار اتفاقية التعاون المبرمة بين القطاعين, بما يسمح بتوفير برامج تكوينية ومرافقة متخصصة تستجيب للاحتياجات الفعلية للحرفيين وتساهم في تطوير قدراتهم ومهاراتهم". كما دعت مداحي إلى "تشجيع الحرفيين المتوجين في هذه الجائزة الوطنية, من خلال إتاحة الفرصة أمامهم للمشاركة في التظاهرات والصالونات الدولية, تقديرا لإبداعاتهم وتميزهم وإسهامهم في المحافظة على المنتجات الحرفية الجزائرية والتعريف بها على المستوى الدولي". من جانبه, جدد رئيس اللجنة والأعضاء "التزامهم ببذل كل الجهود اللازمة خلال مختلف مراحل عملية الانتقاء, والحرص على أن تتم وفق مقاربة مهنية وموضوعية تستند إلى المعايير والشروط المحددة, بما يضمن اختيار منتجات تعكس مستوى الإبداع والأصالة والجودة التي تزخر بها الصناعة التقليدية الجزائرية". و في هذا الإطار , أكدت الوزيرة "استعدادها لتوفير كل الظروف والإمكانيات المناسبة لتمكين اللجنة الوطنية من أداء مهامها في أحسن الظروف, وتحقيق النتائج المرجوة من هذه الجائزة", وفقا للمصدر ذاته.

ml.title: Foire aux Disques : De la mémoire musicale aux défis de demain
ml.description: © Internet Du 24 au 27 septembre, la berge du Palais de la Culture Amadou Hampâté Ba a accueilli la première édition de la Foire aux Disques. Portée par l’Union des Associations des Artistes, Producteurs et Éditeurs du Mali (UAAPREM), la manifestation a consacré quatre jours à l’histoire de la musique malienne, à ses supports et à leur transmission. Placée sous le thème « La musique : hier, aujourd’hui et demain », la foire a réuni artistes, producteurs, éditeurs, collectionneurs et passionnés. Disques vinyles, CD, photographies, affiches, phonographes et autres objets liés à la musique ont retracé plusieurs périodes de la création malienne. L’exposition a rappelé l’évolution des modes d’écoute, de conservation et de diffusion des œuvres. Le public a retrouvé des supports devenus rares. Pour le Directeur du Palais de la Culture, Souleymane Bathiono, l’initiative a constitué « un espace de découverte, de dialogue et de rencontre autour de la musique malienne ». Elle a mis en relation artistes, producteurs, distributeurs, éditeurs et collectionneurs, et donné une place aux œuvres et aux parcours qui ont marqué différentes générations. Mémoire La programmation ne s’est pas limitée aux objets exposés. Conférences, débats, projections, concerts intergénérationnels, showcases et distinctions honorifiques ont rythmé les quatre journées. Les échanges ont porté sur les changements liés au streaming et à la dématérialisation. Souleymane Bathiono a présenté la foire comme une occasion de « préserver la mémoire musicale du Mali tout en ouvrant des perspectives nouvelles pour les générations futures ». Les concerts ont réuni des artistes de différentes générations et proposé des répertoires variés. Les discussions ont porté sur la production musicale, les droits d’auteur, la distribution et les mutations de l’industrie musicale. Ces échanges ont permis aux différents acteurs de confronter leurs expériences et de revenir sur les difficultés de conservation, de diffusion et de transmission. Les projections et les rencontres ont aussi rappelé la nécessité de mieux documenter les parcours, les œuvres et les supports qui ont façonné la musique malienne. Pour Mbaye Boubacar Diarra, Président de l’UAAPREM, cette première édition devait mettre en valeur le chemin parcouru et ouvrir la réflexion sur la suite. Des hommages ont été rendus aux anciennes gloires, aux producteurs et à d’autres acteurs culturels. La foire a cherché à rapprocher les jeunes générations de cet héritage. À l’issue des quatre jours, les organisateurs souhaitent inscrire ce rendez-vous dans la durée et poursuivre le travail de transmission de la mémoire musicale malienne. Joseph Amara Dembélé

sd.title: البرهان يعين مسؤول استخبارات «الدعم السريع» السابق رئيسًا لـ«إشرافية أبيي»
sd.description: الخرطوم، 1 أكتوبر 2026 – عين رئيس مجلس السيادة، القائد العام للجيش عبد الفتاح البرهان، مسؤول استخبارات الدعم السريع السابق، اللواء متقاعد الخير أبو مريدات، رئيسًا لإشرافية أبيي من جانب السودان. وكان أبو مريدات قد شغل في السابق منصب رئيس دائرة الاستخبارات بقوات الدعم السريع، بعد انتدابه إليها من الجيش، وظل في المنصب حتى اندلاع الحرب بين الجيش وقوات الدعم السريع في 15 أبريل 2023. وغادر أبو مريدات السودان بعد وقت قصير من اندلاع القتال، واستقر في العاصمة المصرية القاهرة، قبل إحالته إلى التقاعد خلال العام الجاري. وأصدر رئيس مجلس السيادة قرارًا بتاريخ 23 سبتمبر المنصرم قضى بإعفاء “الفريق شرطة حامد منان، رئيس اللجنة الإشرافية لمنطقة أبيي من جانب السودان، وعيّن اللواء متقاعد الخير عبدالله إدريس أبو مريدات بدلًا منه”. وتُعد اللجنة الإشرافية المشتركة لمنطقة أبيي من جانب السودان الآلية الحكومية الرسمية المعنية بمتابعة شؤون المنطقة المتنازع عليها بين السودان وجنوب السودان، وتضطلع بمهام تتصل بالقضايا الإدارية والإنسانية والأمنية والتنموية، إلى جانب التنسيق مع الجانب الجنوب سوداني والاتحاد الأفريقي وبعثة الأمم المتحدة الأمنية المؤقتة لأبيي «يونسفا». وتعود الترتيبات الخاصة بإدارة أبيي إلى اتفاقية السلام الشامل الموقعة عام 2005، فيما أُقرّت ترتيبات إدارية وأمنية لاحقة في يونيو 2011، في أعقاب تصاعد التوترات حول المنطقة. ويأتي تعيين أبو مريدات في رئاسة الإشرافية … The post البرهان يعين مسؤول استخبارات «الدعم السريع» السابق رئيسًا لـ«إشرافية أبيي» appeared first on سودان تربيون .

zw.title: VP Mohadi to headline KUZANA Creative Economy Conference
zw.description: Langalakhe Mabena, langamabena@gmail.com VICE PRESIDENT Kembo Mohadi will be the guest of honour at the KUZANA Creative Economy Conference, set to be held at Zimbabwe International Trade Fair (ZITF) in Bulawayo on October 8. The conference, which will be held at the exhibition centre’s Hall 2, forms part of the inaugural KUZANA Sport and Creative Economy Expo of Zimbabwe (SCEEZ), which runs from October 7 to 11. VP Mohadi will officially open the conference, which brings together policymakers, investors, development partners and players in Zimbabwe's creative industries. The conference will focus on how the creative economy can be developed into a viable source of investment, employment and economic growth. Two panel discussions are lined up, with the first focusing on “Investing in Zimbabwe's Creative Economy — Unlocking Capital, Markets and Growth”, while the second will examine “Building Competitive Creative Value Chains and ecosystems.” Among the panellists listed on the programme are Nayef H. Al-Fayez who is UNESCO Assistant Director-General for Culture, British Council Regional Arts Director for Sub-Saharan Africa Mrs Farai Ncube, Zimtrade chief executive officer Allan Majuru, Zimbabwe Investment and Development Agency chief legal officer Theresa Muchinguri, and Gerald Ngonyamo, Head of Corporate Affairs and Public Relations at Choice. The conference comes as the Government seeks to increase the economic contribution of sport, arts, culture and other creative industries. The KUZANA initiative is being positioned as a platform to connect talent with capital, investors, brands, institutions and audiences, with the broader objective of moving creative and sporting talent “from talent to GDP. KUZANA SCEEZ is being held under the theme “Towards Vision 2030 through Sports and Creative Industries.” The five-day programme includes exhibitions, conferences, workshops, masterclasses, sporting activities and investment and sponsorship engagements. The inaugural expo is being organised in partnership with Nhimbe Trust, with the ZITF among the host partners. In a statement, Nhimbe Trust describes the gathering as a sport, creative economy and investment convening. “The event is expected to provide a platform for creatives, entrepreneurs and investors to discuss access to finance, markets, intellectual property, professionalisation and the development of sustainable creative businesses. “The creative economy encompasses a wide range of activities, including music, film, fashion, visual arts, design, digital content and other creative enterprises. The sector can create opportunities not only for artistes themselves but also for producers, technicians, marketers, event managers, technology companies and other service providers,” reads part of the statement. The wider KUZANA expo is expected to attract more than 150 exhibitors.
